name: Caring For The Elderly
overview: Scripture commands honoring and respecting the elderly as a reflection of reverence for God, emphasizing this in commands to honor father and mother (Exodus 20:12) and to rise before the hoary head (Leviticus 19:32). The aged are portrayed as bearing a crown of glory when they live righteously (Proverbs 16:31), and believers are urged not to cast off or despise the elderly but to care for them faithfully (Psalms 71:9; Proverbs 23:22). God's justice calls His people to defend and support those vulnerable in old age, including widows, highlighting a Christ-centered responsibility to compassionately care for the elderly (Isaiah 1:17).
